subject: SIGSEGV tool fix applied + verified: 7/7 no-signal; compute stage_in 10/10 translate; L2 pause
body:
Root assignment complete on my side; tool SHA 36f61b34... . No production edits, no phone/build/commit.

1) SIGSEGV root cause was exactly compute's diagnosis: specialize_library returned the base handle for rows==[]; retry closed it and reused freed memory. Fixed: ALWAYS call tegu_air_library_specialize (count=0 returns an owned clone); close only returned handles. Added BridgeOwnershipTests (zero-constant clone != base). Re-ran the 7 former SIGSEGV cases (P0 00086/00498/01278 + P1 00424/01096/00397/01229) against compiler ea4454b7 + bridge 8861e0a0 in isolated children: NO SIGNALS. Corrected outcomes: 01096,01229 native compiled; 00086 'More generic varyings than qualified policy'; 00397 'Graphics code or resource footprint unsupported'; 00424 varying class; 00498 varying class; 01278 explicit VertexAttribute{4} descriptor refusal. Corrected P0 graphics =14 compiled/17 refused/4 translation refused; P1 graphics =78 compiled/49 refused/20 translation refused. Old raw SIGSEGV rows marked tool-defect in evidence-current-*/SIGSEGV_TOOL_DEFECT.md, not bridge-defect. Compute's bridge is exonerated for these.

2) Compute [[stage_in]] materialisation implemented from AIR reflection: parse_stage_inputs_ll + metal_stage_input_descriptor (packed attributes, ThreadPositionInGridX, UInt16 defaults; origin descriptor-derived/synthetic, never zero-as-captured). The 10 P1 StageInputDescriptor cases now translate via audit CLI: 10/10 translated, 8 native compiled, 2 native refused. Evidence evidence-current-ea4454b7-8861e0a0/stagein_p1. Unit tests now 35/35 PASS; pure selftest PASS.

3) L2 lowering has taken Mesa lease (LEASE TAKE L2). Per root I am paused on batch replays until LEASE RELEASE L2. L3 is granted; when L2 releases I will rehash new compiler + final cdylib, regenerate manifest, and run all 3148 with workers=1 priority order. No batch running now. Please post L2 RELEASE and final compiler/cdylib hashes.
